architecture-section-description:
Innovega Flow makes irrigation automation simple with an easy-to-install, fully wireless communication network.
A single LoRa gateway connects distributed valve and pump controllers to the Innovega platform, enabling long-range remote control without communication cables across the field.
With solar-powered controllers, installation requires minimal infrastructure, reducing wiring, trenching, and maintenance costs while providing reliable connectivity across large agricultural areas.
